## Streaming implementation in `openai/openai-node`

### Core low-level implementation

**`src/core/streaming.ts`** — the foundation. Defines:
- `class Stream<Item> implements AsyncIterable<Item>` — wraps an async iterator over parsed SSE data, with `tee()` (split into two independently-consumable streams) and `toReadableStream()`/`fromReadableStream()` (bridge to web `ReadableStream`, used for browser/frontend relay of a backend-produced stream).
- `Stream.fromSSEResponse(response, controller, client)` — the entry point that turns a raw `fetch` `Response` into a `Stream`. It delegates to the internal `_iterSSEMessages()` generator, which uses `iterSSEChunks()` + `SSEDecoder` (line-based, double-newline-delimited SSE parsing) built on `src/internal/decoders/line.ts`.

**Dispatch into the streaming path**: `src/internal/parse.ts::defaultParseResponse()` (line ~24) checks `props.options.stream` — if true, it calls either a custom `props.options.__streamClass.fromSSEResponse(...)` or the default `Stream.fromSSEResponse(...)`. This is invoked from `APIPromise` (`src/core/api-promise.ts`), whose `parse()`/`then()` route the raw response through `parseResponse` (defaulting to `defaultParseResponse`).

So the request pipeline is: resource method → `this._client.post/get(...)` with `stream: true` in options → `client.ts` performs the fetch → `APIPromise` wraps the response promise → `internal/parse.ts` detects `options.stream` and calls `Stream.fromSSEResponse` → caller gets an `AsyncIterable<Item>`.

### Higher-level streaming helpers (in `src/lib/`)

Built on top of the core `Stream`/SSE machinery, these provide event-emitter style ergonomics (`.on('chunk')`, `.finalChatCompletion()`, etc.):
- `src/lib/EventStream.ts` — base class `EventStream<EventTypes>` (abort controller, event emitter semantics, `_fromReadableStream`).
- `src/lib/ChatCompletionStream.ts` — `class ChatCompletionStream` extends `AbstractChatCompletionRunner`, static `createChatCompletion()`/`fromReadableStream()`.
- `src/lib/ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.ts` — used by `runTools()` when `body.stream` is true.
- `src/lib/responses/ResponseStream.ts` — `class ResponseStream` extends `EventStream`, static `createResponse()`.
- `src/lib/AssistantStream.ts` — `class AssistantStream` extends `EventStream`, statics `createAssistantStream`, `createThreadAssistantStream`, `createToolAssistantStream`.

### Public API methods that route into streaming

| Method | File | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| `client.chat.completions.create({stream:true})` | `src/resources/chat/completions/completions.ts:63-79` | returns `APIPromise<Stream<ChatCompletionChunk>>` via `stream: body.stream ?? false` passed to `_client.post` |
| `client.chat.completions.stream(body)` | same file, line 221-226 | returns `ChatCompletionStream.createChatCompletion(...)` |
| `client.chat.completions.runTools(body)` when `body.stream` | same file, line 195-217 | returns `ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.runTools(...)` |
| `client.responses.create({stream:true})` | `src/resources/responses/responses.ts:96-122` | `APIPromise<Stream<ResponseStreamEvent>>` |
| `client.responses.retrieve(id, {stream:true})` | same file, line 140-168 | same pattern |
| `client.responses.stream(body)` | same file, line 201-205 | `ResponseStream.createResponse(...)` |
| `client.completions.create({stream:true})` (legacy completions) | `src/resources/completions.ts:29-43` | `APIPromise<Stream<Completion>>` |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.stream(threadId, body)` | `src/resources/beta/threads/runs/runs.ts:232-234` | `AssistantStream.createAssistantStream(...)` |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.createAndStream(...)` (deprecated) | same file, line 165-171 | same underlying call |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.submitToolOutputsStream(...)` | same file, line 294-300 | `AssistantStream.createToolAssistantStream(...)` |
| `client.beta.threads.createAndRun({stream:true})` | `src/resources/beta/threads/threads.ts:145-163` | `APIPromise<Stream<AssistantStreamEvent>>`, sets `__synthesizeEventData: true` |
| `client.beta.threads.createAndRunStream(...)` | same file, line 182-184 | `AssistantStream.createThreadAssistantStream(...)` |

Realtime (`src/resources/realtime/`, `src/beta/realtime/`) uses a separate WebSocket-based transport (`ws-adapter*.ts`), not the SSE `Stream` class — I did not trace that path in depth here since it's architecturally distinct from HTTP SSE streaming.

### What I did not verify
- The exact bytes-level correctness of `SSEDecoder`/`LineDecoder` parsing (didn't read `internal/decoders/line.ts` in full).
- Image generation streaming (`ImageEditStreamEvent`, `ImageGenStreamEvent` seen referenced in `client.ts` imports) — didn't inspect `resources/images.ts` for its `.stream`-equivalent, though it likely follows the same `Stream<T>` pattern as chat/responses.
- Realtime WebSocket internals (`internal/ws-adapter*.ts`, `beta/realtime/*`) — confirmed they exist and are separate from the SSE path, but did not read their implementation.
